summary.en: The falling-sand physics sandbox in your browser: 500-plus elements reacting freely across chemistry, circuits and construction.
summary.zh: 浏览器版「沙子模拟器」，500+ 元素自由反应，玩化学、玩电路、玩建造都行。

description.en: Choose a material from the element bar and paint it onto the canvas; everything reacts by rule — water plus fire becomes steam, acid eats through metal, current travels. No goals, no win state, pure sandbox.
description.zh: 从元素栏选一种材料在画布上涂画，元素之间会按规则反应（水+火=蒸汽、酸腐蚀金属、导电……），没有目标，纯沙盒。

howto.en: Mouse — pick an element and draw on the canvas.

tip.en: A sandbox with nothing to win keeps people around far longer than average, and user-made creations pile up on their own. It's on the heavy side (plenty of element textures) with a deep ruleset — embed the whole thing in an iframe rather than forking the code.
tip.zh: 没有输赢的沙盒，用户平均停留时长非常可观，且自发创作内容多。缺点是体积偏大（元素贴图多）、规则库复杂，建议整体嵌入 iframe 而不是自己改。
